{{Quote|At last, my search is over! I was beginning to fear someone else had killed you and deprived me of the pleasure.|Darth Bandon, to Revan|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
The '''mission to Hrakert Station''' was a confrontation during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and redeemed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], and reigning Dark Lord [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Shadow Hand]], [[Darth Bandon]]. It took place in a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] harvesting base called [[Hrakert Station]], located on the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. The [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] resulted in Bandon and his two [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] comrades' [[Death/Legends|deaths]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Find Bastila and bring her to me. Alive if possible.''"<br />"''As you command, Master.|Darth Malak and Darth Bandon|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
In [[3956 BBY]], the final [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="KotOR CG" /> the former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and amnesiac [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] assisted in the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]]'s [[Rescue of Bastila Shan|escape]] from the [[Destruction of Taris|destruction]] of the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. After traveling to the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], Revan was [[Jedi training/Legends|retrained]] as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] by the local [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|Jedi Council]]. When Revan completed his training, he was tasked by the Council to find an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] called the [[Star Forge]], which was under Revan's former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] and reigning Dark Lord [[Darth Malak]]'s control.<ref name="KotOR game" />

After locating a fourth Rakatan [[Star Map]] which was needed to determine the Star Forge's location, Malak's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and [[Shadow Hand]], [[Darth Bandon]], and two [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] found Revan and his companions in the [[Hrakert Station]], a Republic [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] harvesting base, on the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].<ref name="KotOR game" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|You were on the ''Endar Spire''! You killed Trask. You'll pay for that!''"<br />"''Your words mean nothing to me&hellip; unless you wish to beg for your life. No? Then I shall try to make this both quick and painful!|Revan and Darth Bandon|<ref name="KotOR game" />}}
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Bandon expressed to Revan his fear that someone else had killed the Jedi, thereby depriving the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] the pleasure of killing Revan himself. Bandon told his adversary that he would be no match for him, even though the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had previously [[Ambush on Tatooine (Jedi Civil War)|killed]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Calo Nord]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The former Dark Lord asked Bandon how he ended up at the station, and Bandon replied that he had used the same route underwater that Darth Revan and Darth Malak used during their search for the Star Forge. Revan assured Bandon that he would pay for the Republic [[Ensign/Legends|ensign]] [[Trask Ulgo]]'s [[Death/Legends|death]], since Bandon killed Ulgo when the Sith Lord led an [[Attack on the Endar Spire|attack]] on Bastila Shan's Republic warship ''[[Endar Spire]]'' over Taris. However, Bandon stated that Revan's words meant nothing to him, asking Revan if he wanted to beg for his life. Bandon and his two Dark Jedi accompanying the Shadow Hand engaged Revan and his companions in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], but were ultimately defeated by the former Sith Lord and his allies.<ref name="KotOR game" />

==Aftermath==
Shortly after his death, Bandon's head was sliced off his body by [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]]. They had preserved the head, feeling that there was power inside. It had remained that way for [[3643 BBY|over 300 years]], which at that time it was placed in the [[Royal Museum of Alderaan|House Alde Royal Museum]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Hrakert Station first appeared in the [[2003]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="KotOR game" />

The planet on which Revan battles Bandon is determined by the order in which the fourth of the five Star Maps that lead to the Star Forge's location is obtained. Bandon could confront Revan on the desert world [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], Manaan, or the Sith tombworld [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. Bandon could also confront Revan if he returned to the location of the second and third Star Maps.<ref name="KotOR SG">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
